mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,a.granularity,a.material_type_code,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.drill_round,a.system_code,sys.short_name AS system_short_name,sys.name AS system_name,m.attachment_id,a.owner_id,a.created_by,a.created_at,a.updated_by,a.updated_at

a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,'RELEASE_DRILL' AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.granularity,a.material_type_code,a.drill_round,a.system_code,sys.short_name AS system_short_name,sys.name AS system_name,m.attachment_id,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_release_drill a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type='RELEASE_DRILL' AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.project_id=a.project_id AND c.system_code=a.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem sys ON sys.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND sys.code=c.system_code AND sys.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=0 AND a.granularity=#{granularity} AND a.material_type_code=#{materialTypeCode} AND a.system_code=#{systemCode} AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_release_drill SET doc_name=#{p.docName},granularity=#{p.granularity},material_type_code=#{p.materialTypeCode},drill_round=#{p.drillRound},system_code=#{p.systemCode},updated_by=#{p.updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_release_drill SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{deletedBy},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment m JOIN dm_release_drill a ON a.id=m.business_id AND a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.business_type='RELEASE_DRILL' AND m.business_id=#{id} AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_release_drill a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY a.doc_code ASC,a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_release_drill SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_release_drill WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT id,project_id,granularity,material_type_code,drill_round,system_code,doc_code,doc_name,owner_id FROM dm_release_drill WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT project_id FROM dm_release_drill WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
